limitations: AP-BOOT only (docs/dev/detector-simulation/card-AP-BOOT.md): a pinned rerun of the official Allpix Squared example examples/example.conf with its two external files, unchanged; only number_of_events = 10, multithreading = false and random_seed are overridden (allpix -o key=value)
10 events are not physics statistics; the charge band [10687.5, 42750] e is a plausibility check, not physics validation and not an external numerical oracle

the output folder is the program's default <working folder>/output (ATTEMPT_ROOT/output): Allpix resolves a relative output_directory against the configuration file's folder and the shared layer binds a logical root only at the start of an argument, so no output_directory override is written

libraries of Geant4, ROOT and the dependencies are found through the executable's own LC_RPATH entries; the library path variable names only ENV_ROOT/allpix/lib because the shared layer binds one leading logical root per value (H3 question in the W4A report)

the extractor reads data members through ROOT's streamer information (emulated classes, TTree::Draw on member names) without loading libAllpixObjects; it needs the ROOT Python bindings in the controller's interpreter, else check --probe answers missing-dependency and a run's collect is invalid
no efficiency, waveform, scan or cross-tool coupling; a completed run is verification at most, never physical validity

checks.hits_required_in: every detector of the detector input
checks.charge_sign: negative: GenericPropagation in this example propagates electrons only, so every PixelCharge charge_ is < 0 (PixelCharge.cpp, PulseTransferModule.cpp at the pinned commit)
checks.band_rule: median over events of the per-event sum over band_detector pixels of PixelCharge::getAbsoluteCharge() (= |charge_|) lies in [low, high]; [0.5, 2] x 75 e/um x 285 um (cmsp1 sensor_thickness)
